entries.3a3566e3e6d65f58: For pneumatic equipment, it secured sales agency rights early, from the era when pneumatic equipment first emerged around 1960, and it has sales expertise built over many years and close trading relationships with its customers. It promotes the acquisition by sales staff of the national qualification of Pneumatic Equipment Assembly Technician and of the manufacturer SE qualification for FA robots, and it has a structure in which sales staff with technical expertise make proposals for cost reduction and upgrading at manufacturing sites. Its suppliers number approximately 1,200, and it has a structure to accurately meet customer needs.

entries.5d05c1d743975ef5: A specialized trading company dealing in machinery and tools, which purchases control equipment, FA equipment and industrial equipment and sells them directly to manufacturing production sites.
entries.5d2bd61bb3a5e6f6: As its basic management policy, it upholds its corporate motto of 'Credibility First' and says it will pursue value-added sales activities that differentiate it from other companies, by focusing on FA equipment centered on industrial robots, in which it has long anticipated demand for labor-saving and automation at manufacturing sites, and by using its superior proposal capability as an 'FA planner' as a weapon. As priority issues under the medium-term management plan 'Next Stage 2029', it cites developing new sales markets, discovering high value-added products with low environmental impact, growing and securing talent through investment in people, improving operational efficiency and customer satisfaction through updates to core systems and the like, and strengthening corporate governance.
entries.5e8b24f3d0b9d591: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,107 million.

entries.76ab651b6b4758d8: This is a product category covering pneumatic equipment, electronic sensors, pressure sensors, fluid couplings, vacuum equipment, shock absorbers and others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,134 million. In addition to standalone units used to automate parts of production processes, it handles components incorporated into equipment such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment, liquid crystal substrate manufacturing equipment and digital device manufacturing facilities.
entries.9c58aa74c53a6794: This is a single business segment that sells control equipment, FA equipment, industrial equipment and others. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,061 million. For domestic transactions, it purchases products from leading manufacturers and sells them mainly to major users; for overseas transactions, it sells to overseas users mainly products purchased from leading domestic manufacturers. The company, three consolidated subsidiaries (Toba (Shanghai) Trading Co., Ltd., Izumi Tech Co., Ltd., and Izumi Technical Lab Co., Ltd.), two non-consolidated subsidiaries (TOBA(THAILAND)CO.,LTD. and TOBA,INC.(VIETNAM)CO.,LTD), and one affiliate (Dongguan Toba Machinery Equipment Co., Ltd.; maintenance services) make up the group.
entries.9e77b66f90b96aae: This is a product category covering industrial robots, automatic assembly machines, surface mounting systems, laser processing machines, precision coating equipment and others. entries.c632941deb5aadb8: The company's group is a single segment in the sale of machinery, tools and equipment, and the breakdown by product of consolidated revenue of ¥29,061 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is FA equipment ¥13,486 million, control equipment ¥8,134 million and industrial equipment ¥7,439 million. By region, Japan accounted for ¥25,795 million, China for ¥3,044 million and other regions for ¥221 million, and there is no specific customer accounting for 10% or more of revenue. In MD&A, it analyzes that demand for high-performance semiconductors remained firm against a backdrop of wider adoption of generative AI and expanding data center investment, while sales to automotive and in-vehicle component customers fell well below the previous year due to sluggish capital investment by automotive-related companies.
